title: RetroAchievements
description: EmuDeck now uses the RetroAchievements new API and we've added support for Dolphin RetroAchievements setup

title: Resolution selector
description: Change the resolution of more emulators from within EmuDeck, added PPSSPP, Xemu, Vita3K, Azahar and PrimeHack. Fixed a bug where resolutions weren't being applied on installation.

title: Embedded videos
description: Fixed the youtube video error on embedded videos in the app

title: AutoMap Controllers
description: Enable AutoMap to allow EmuDeck to set up your controls in emulators that doesn't detect controllers automatically. This will also enable auto setup of controllers for up to 4 players and support for other controllers like the Steam Controller, 8BitDo, Xbox, DualSense, other SteamOS handhelds, etc

title: Steam Machine improvements
description: Improvements to Steam Machine support like default 1080P / 4K setup in selected emulators

title: Ryujinx Gyro
description: SteamDeckGyroDSU installed automatically when setting up Ryujinx. Steam Deck only, we are investigating in how to add support for the Steam Controller

title: Import / Export
description: Export your EmuDeck installation to another device. Steam Deck to Steam Machine, Linux <-> Windows, etc.
